params.1273: Bind a mind rune at the mind altar.
params.1274: Obtain a mind talisman. You need one to enter the Mind Altar. You can get one from Apprentice Clara.
params.1275: Go to the Mind Altar. Normally you have to travel there, but Carwen Essencebinder can teleport you there just this once.
params.1276: Click on the mind altar with at least one rune essence to create mind runes. You will need your mind talisman with you.
params.2225: You need runes to cast any powerful spell. Air runes and mind runes together cast Wind Strike. An elemental staff (such as an air staff, or Mindspike) can be used in place of that rune type.
